hero.lead: Salsa, bachata and more: Latin nights out in one place, updated day by day. We're in beta and starting from Milan: the map is already open.

mapTeaser.description: See where people are dancing tonight, night by night, in real time — freely, no sign-in needed. Every night has its own page, with times, price and how to get there. For now it covers only Milan, and the map itself is in Italian: we're opening it city by city.
mapTeaser.hint: No login to look around — only to like or join a night.

status.intro: Ballastasera is online, but it isn't finished: we open one feature at a time, once it's really ready. Below is what you can already use and what's on its way.
status.feedback: A night is missing or something looks off? Message us on Instagram

count.title: How to dance bachata
count.subtitle: Four beats, then it starts over
count.explanation: The music runs in groups of four beats, the same throughout the song. On the first four you move to the right: a step on 1, 2 and 3, and on 4 you don't step but do a tap — you set your foot next to the other one, without shifting weight onto it, and that's where the hip movement comes from. On the next four you do it all again to the left: steps on 5, 6 and 7, tap on 8. Soft knees, count in time, and you're already on the floor.

support.text: We're building Ballastasera as a team of two, in the evenings, between one job and the next — because we dance too, and a place like this didn't exist yet. If you like the project, buy us a coffee: it helps us keep it alive.
